instruction: Enable the On-Screen Keyboard as a motor accessibility aid and keep it open while completing the task. Go to https://www.handbook.unsw.edu.au/undergraduate/programs/2022/3778 and view the 2025 version of the program. Under the Disciplinary Component, open Computer Science (COMPA1). In the Course Cores section, view more information for Data Structures and Algorithms (COMP2521). Using the On-Screen Keyboard, write the complete prerequisite expression for COMP2521 in a sticky note exactly as shown in the handbook, including every `or` between the course codes.
gt_steps: Enable the On-Screen Keyboard as a motor accessibility aid and keep it open while completing the task.
Open the 2022 UNSW Computer Science program page in Google Chrome.
Use the year selector to view the 2025 version of the program.
Scroll to the Disciplinary Component section.
In the Course Cores section, find Data Structures and Algorithms (COMP2521).
Select See More Information for COMP2521.
Find the Enrolment Requirements and identify the complete prerequisite expression: `COMP1511 or DPST1091 or COMP1917 or COMP1921`.
Using the On-Screen Keyboard, write `COMP1511 or DPST1091 or COMP1917 or COMP1921` in a sticky note, preserving every `or`.

points: COMP1511 or DPST1091 or COMP1917 or COMP1921
